blocks.x: Did you look at yourself in sort of a way, like with Alan, did you look at like, it's because you were old what, fourteen years, Bob? Yeah. And look with Earl and with Huey Smith, those kind of guys, did you look at yourself as a mentor in a way?
That you were a good kid.
Yeah. They always, all of them are always respecting me, you know, as a musician, you know.
Well most of your guys, you were, I mean, who were a little older than, say, Earl and Alan, those people, did you all, was everybody really helpful to the younger guys in general?
Yeah. Yeah, man. Yeah. But man, I knew Earl was going to make it some kind of way when he can't push stuff, come around and drill and drive. He was ambitious and also Huey and Alan, man.
What do you mean ambitious? What do you mean Earl was ambitious?

Well he's always fooling with the music, you know, always interested, man. You know. Huey and all of them, you know. Yeah. Yeah. And then they used to have Boca, Boca started coming around there too with them.
Yeah, man. And Boca and Alan used to play them organs in the dude drop, you know.
Yeah. I used to play piano but I didn't fool the organ. You know, they used to play the organ man, you know, in the dude drop, him and Boca. Yeah.
